login=apis.spotify.login(username=spotify_username, password=spotify_pw)
token=login['access_token']
# get active subscription(s)
subs=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_premium_subscriptions(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    subs.extend(page)
    if len(page)<20:
        break
    page_index+=1
now=datetime.now()
active=[]
for s in subs:
    end_dt=datetime.fromisoformat(s['end_date'])
    if end_dt>=now:
        active.append((end_dt, s))
active.sort(key=lambda x:x[0], reverse=True)
print('now', now.isoformat())
print('active_count', len(active))
for end_dt,s in active:
    print('active_id', s['premium_subscription_id'], 'end', s['end_date'])
# choose subscription with latest end
end_dt, s = active[0]
remaining_seconds=(end_dt-now).total_seconds()
avg_month_days=30.4375
months_remaining_raw=remaining_seconds/(avg_month_days*24*3600)
months_rounded=int(math.floor(months_remaining_raw+0.5))
print('months_remaining_raw', months_remaining_raw)
print('months_rounded', months_rounded)
months_rounded_calendar=(end_dt.year-now.year)*12 + (end_dt.month-now.month)
# adjust calendar rounding slightly
if (end_dt.day < now.day) or (end_dt.day==now.day and (end_dt.hour, end_dt.minute, end_dt.second) < (now.hour, now.minute, now.second)):
